_note: Expected sections validated against the corpus snapshot ingested 14/08/2026 (124 sections, manifest collected 09/08/2026). A section code existing does not prove its content answers the question, and INZ revises content while section codes stay the same, so re-validate after any corpus refresh. expected_behavior is one of: answer, clarify. Only retrieval is scored today; abstention and clarification quality need ask.py and human judgment, and are deliberately not automated yet. Questions whose answers fall outside the current corpus live in docs/COVERAGE-GAPS.md, so this file measures retrieval rather than coverage.
